exposure: Trial of labor after two previous cesarean deliveries (TOL)
trial of labor (TOL) after two CD
outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit admission rate
cohort: 2719 women with two previous cesarean deliveries
finding: Trial of labor after two cesarean deliveries, when following a strict protocol, is a reasonable alternative to elective third repeat cesarean delivery and is associated with favorable outcomes.
mod_finding: Trial of labor after two previous cesarean deliveries was associated with a higher uterine rupture rate compared to elective repeat cesarean but similar rates of other maternal complications and more favorable neonatal outcomes.
